summary: The paid post or the seat: {senior member} tells you a paid post that {the body} fills is opening, and it fits you.
realLife: He won an unpaid Northampton, Massachusetts, council seat, then chose not to run again and sought the city solicitor's salaried post, which he held until a Democratic council replaced him.
gates: You hold a seat on a local body.
{the post} is opening and your credentials fit it.
choices: seek the post and give up the seat
ask whether you can keep both, which the place's rules decide

branches.then: Years later the other side takes the majority and gives the post to one of its own.
The vote splits, and you owe whoever breaks the tie.
Whether the steady pay is worth giving up the seat you worked for.
